_readme: Models released with AxonID. The model files (.safetensors) are not stored in git (each is about 150 MB, over GitHub's 100 MB file limit). Run python -m utils.fetch_models to download them into this folder (models/), or download them from the GitHub release page. Do not edit this file; your own trained models go in models/user/ and appear in the segmentation menu automatically.

models.label: AxonID 1.0 augmented
models.notes: Same as the reference model, trained with the AxonID augmentation recipe (utils/recipe.py).

models.label: AxonID 1.0 (no augmentation)
models.notes: Reference model: UNet++/DenseNet169, class weights 1:2:2, trained on 20 rabbit 40X images (10 held out for validation), seed 1.
